name: Otome Banchou
source:
"Well then, Come with me on a fun date~!"
A cute Banchou who warmly gives maidens advice. 
His appearance is slender and graceful, almost more maidenly than most girls, but in order to help settle maiden's worries he can show his manly side.
He's the younger brother of do-S and Soothing Banchos.
